notes: Pyre 1.2.2 — a safety + roleplay-quality patch. Security: your API key is no longer sent to a provider's NEW host after you change its URL (it's cleared at Test, Browse, and Save until you re-enter it). Data safety: a factory reset now warns before any image that can't be backed up would be lost, backups include in-progress character drafts and the BotBooru avatar original, image types (MIME) survive a restore, and a corrupt attachment is caught instead of silently breaking. Roleplay: your long-term memory recap AND Live Sheet state now refresh correctly after you edit a message or use Continue — no more stale context injected as truth; out-of-character [OOC] notes are no longer voiced by characters as dialogue; and a Stop or error right after swiping back to a good reply no longer deletes that reply and its branch. Interface: the library tab is clearer (Characters / Personas / Lorebooks), Chat Settings are grouped by task, provider setup is renamed 'Creator settings' where it configures the AI Creator, and a one-tap 'Set up provider' prompt appears (keeping your draft) if you try to send before connecting one.
